hooks.prompt: Plan was just approved. MANDATORY: spawn the zensu:tdd-manager subagent now and pass the approved plan content as its feature specification. This is the default and applies to ALL code-related plans — new features, refactors, bug fixes, integration work, schema/config changes that include logic, and skeleton/scaffold work. Do NOT implement the code yourself. Two narrow exceptions: (1) plan contains zero code changes (pure documentation: README, CHANGELOG, comments-only; or config files with no logic) — proceed directly and state in one sentence why TDD does not apply; (2) the user's approval message contains an EXPLICIT TDD negation matching one of: 'no tdd', 'skip tdd', 'no tdd-manager', "don't use tdd", 'direct edit', 'kein tdd', 'ohne tdd-manager', or a clear equivalent that names TDD or tdd-manager. Generic urgency or action phrases ('go ahead', 'start now', 'gleich arbeiten', 'los gehts', 'immediately', 'mach mal', 'jetzt umsetzen', 'implement', 'go') DO NOT qualify — delegate anyway. Auto Mode is NOT an override; under Auto Mode, delegating to tdd-manager IS the autonomous action. If unsure whether the override is explicit enough, delegate.
The TDD manager has finished implementation. Run /reflect now to review this session's changes in your current context before proceeding with any further steps.
The code reviewer has finished. Present the review report to the user and ask if any findings should be addressed.

hooks.command: bash -c 'HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null) || { echo "zensu: not a git repository, pulse session skipped"; exit 0; }; BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$BRANCH" ] && BRANCH="detached"; echo "zensu: pulse session ready — HEAD=$HEAD branch=$BRANCH"'
